name: Clean Tabletop
description: A bare wooden table surface under even overhead lighting. No clutter, no distractions. Standard starting environment for manipulation policy evaluation.
preview_description: Plain wooden table, overhead camera view. White walls, even fluorescent lighting. A single colored cube sits at table center.

name: Cluttered Tabletop
description: Table surface with 5-15 distractor objects (mugs, pens, paper, small boxes). Tests policy robustness to visual clutter and accidental contact with irrelevant objects.

conditions.obstacles: distractors may block direct grasp paths
conditions.physics: MuJoCo default with randomized object masses (0.05-0.5kg)

preview_description: Wooden table covered with mugs, pens, crumpled paper, and small boxes. Target cube partially obscured by a mug. Shadows from angled desk lamp.

name: ALOHA Bimanual Workspace
description: MuJoCo recreation of the ALOHA dual-arm tabletop from Zhao et al. Two ViperX 300 arms facing each other across a shared workspace. Used for ACT transfer cube and insertion tasks.
preview_description: Two robot arms face each other across a narrow aluminum table. A red cube sits between them. Overhead camera captures the full workspace.

name: ALOHA Kitchen
description: Kitchen countertop environment for Mobile ALOHA cooking tasks. Includes stove, pan, utensils, and food items. Long-horizon tasks in a realistic kitchen layout.

conditions.objects: pan, spatula, plates, food items (shrimp, vegetables)
conditions.obstacles: stove knobs, cabinet edges, hanging utensils
conditions.physics: MuJoCo default with stove heat zone (visual only)

preview_description: Kitchen countertop with a gas stove, frying pan, and scattered ingredients. Mobile ALOHA base visible at counter edge. Warm kitchen lighting.

name: Flat Terrain (Locomotion)
description: Infinite flat ground plane for basic locomotion evaluation. Domain randomization over friction (0.3-1.5), added mass (0-2kg), and motor strength (80-120%). Standard first test for any locomotion policy.

conditions.physics: Isaac Sim (dt=0.005s, 4096 parallel envs, aggressive DR)

preview_description: Vast flat grey ground plane stretching to the horizon. A single quadruped robot stands at center. No features, no obstacles — pure locomotion test.

name: Rough Terrain Outdoor
description: Procedurally generated uneven terrain with rocks, slopes (up to 25 degrees), and small gaps (up to 30cm). Tests robustness of locomotion policies beyond flat ground.

conditions.physics: Isaac Sim (dt=0.005s, terrain curriculum, DR on friction/mass)

preview_description: Hilly terrain with scattered rocks and uneven ground. Quadruped navigating a 15-degree slope with loose gravel. Distant mountains in background.

name: Parkour Obstacle Course
description: Progressive parkour curriculum from Cheng et al. Includes stepping stones, gaps (20-60cm), ramps, and elevated platforms (up to 60cm). Teacher policy has privileged terrain info.

conditions.physics: Isaac Sim (dt=0.005s, curriculum progression, DR on friction/mass/motor strength)

preview_description: Series of concrete platforms at varying heights with gaps between them. A quadruped mid-leap over a 40cm gap. Course progresses from easy to extreme.

name: Indoor Flat (Humanoid)
description: Indoor room with flat floor for humanoid locomotion and basic manipulation. Includes simple furniture (table, chair) as context. Used for G1 whole-body control evaluation.

conditions.objects: table, chair, small box on table

preview_description: Sparse indoor room with tile floor, a simple table, and a chair. Humanoid robot stands in the center. Neutral lighting, white walls.

name: Indoor Flight Cage
description: Netted indoor flight cage (3m x 3m x 2.5m) with ArUco landing pads and motion capture reference frame. Standard drone testing environment.

conditions.surface: foam mat floor with ArUco landing pads
conditions.lighting: even overhead LED (600 lux, no flickering)

preview_description: Small netted room with foam floor. Two ArUco markers on the ground. A tiny drone hovers at 1m altitude, camera angled downward.

name: Robomimic PickPlaceCan
description: Standard Robomimic benchmark environment. Franka arm must pick a soda can from the table and place it in a target bin. From Mandlekar et al. (CoRL 2022).
preview_description: Franka arm next to a metal table. A red soda can sits on the table, a grey bin to the right. Two camera views: agent-view and eye-in-hand.
